title: Start and attach
text: A session registers in its mapped project, or in its authority's organization outside a project. Its scope stays fixed across retries and reinstallation. Calls below the machine-scope serving floor refuse with the required release and recovery: start the agent inside a registered project folder.
verification: Source regressions verify real machine-bound HTTP hooks persist org-owned sessions across Claude, Codex and Cursor. An unbound or mismatched credential refuses with reconnect-machine recovery. Deployed harness proof remains pending.
